deferred.live: Requires real external provider calls and credentials.
deferred.real_data: Requires explicitly mounted or sealed real company source bytes.
deferred.requires_corpus: Requires the owner's cross-repository golden document corpus.
deferred.owner_local_checkout: Requires an authorized private, unexported, or separately deployed owner checkout/runtime.
deferred.deployed_pdf_runtime: Requires a configured deployed OCR/PDF runtime and its model artifacts.
deferred.coverage_artifact: Requires the separate FC-1204 full branch-coverage evidence run.
deferred.retirement_protocol: Requires the explicit R9 publication and retirement observation window.
deferred.requires_symlink: Requires runner permission to create symbolic links.

linux.markexpr: not (live or real_data or requires_corpus or owner_local_checkout or deployed_pdf_runtime or coverage_artifact or retirement_protocol or windows_native)

windows.markexpr: not (live or real_data or requires_corpus or owner_local_checkout or deployed_pdf_runtime or coverage_artifact or retirement_protocol or posix_native or requires_symlink)
